title: Four general facts about completion: surjectivity, exactness for flat quotients, and finiteness
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four facts about completion: surjectivity lifts from the reduction modulo the ideal, surjectivity of the map lifts, a short exact sequence with flat quotient stays exact after completion, and the natural map from the completed base tensor a finite module to its completion is surjective (statement lines 22787-22801). The proof does not treat the four separately: it uses Nakayama over the nilpotent truncations to propagate surjectivity, obtains exactness from left exactness of limits plus flatness, and reduces the finiteness statement to a free presentation (proof lines 22803-22840). Reusing the first assertion for the last is the step that keeps the proof short. H2.
